status: A-eye and natural-mouth direction accepted for development; personality-specific eye acting required. Portraits sample one reaction; runtime controls remain to implement.
userDirection: Keep A eyes and natural mouth anatomy across the whole cast including Shelly. Personalities must shape the facial expressions of the eyes as development continues.
eyeRule: Use A as the appealing eye design and rendering direction; each personality determines its own resting gaze, lid pose where appropriate, attention shifts and expressive timing throughout conversation.
mouthRule: Species-specific natural mouth or mouthparts; avoid fixed human smiles, human lips and human teeth. Octopus/squid beaks stay hidden under the arm crown; jellyfish has no mouth.

eyeActing.engaged: Eyes track new details with lively focus, then return to the speaker.
